observations.behavior: The workflow's conditional check for changes triggering the replay vision temporal worker was broadened. The previous pattern explicitly listed several specific paths and files, while the new pattern uses a broader directory prefix and adds the workflow file itself to the check.
observations.code_quote: if git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qE '^products/replay_vision/backend/|^posthog/temporal/common|^posthog/management/commands/start_temporal_worker.py$|^pyproject.toml$|^bin/temporal-django-worker$|^posthog/clickhouse/migrations/|^.github/workflows/container-images-cd.yml$'; then
observations.posthog_connection: This change could allow the CI workflow to detect relevant changes for the replay vision temporal worker more broadly, potentially including changes to the backend directory or the workflow file itself, rather than requiring a change to a specific sub-path or model file. This could help ensure the worker is rebuilt or checked when relevant backend or workflow changes occur.
